title: Printer Supply Request Notice
paragraphs: The printer on the third floor is running low on paper and ink. Any staff member who needs printer supply should submit a request form. Copies of the form are kept in the supply cabinet next to the reception desk.

Write your name, department, and the item you need on the form. For an urgent request, call extension 205 instead of waiting for the usual form process. The supply team will notify you by email once your order is ready for pickup.
The team will also maintain the printer and other shared equipment every Friday afternoon. Please report any machine problem before Friday morning so it can be added to the maintenance list.
Thank you for your cooperation, Office Management

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: To announce a new office location
To explain how staff can request printer supply
To introduce a new employee in the supply team
To cancel the Friday maintenance schedule

options: In the supply cabinet next to the reception desk
In the archive room on the second floor

questions.stem: What should staff do for an urgent request?
options: Send an email to the supply team
Wait for the usual form process

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the maintenance schedule?
